adapters.mechanism: One canonical hourly RRULE whose BYMINUTE is rotated 00/15/30/45 by each invocation.
adapters.documented_platform_floor: Ordinary eligible paid recurring tasks officially support up to once per hour; quarter-shift mutation is an RRuleR experiment rather than a documented 15-minute recurrence primitive.
adapters.observed_limitation: Cannot create a rescue wake inside the current quarter when the reasoning invocation ends early.

adapters.mechanism: ChatGPT Work event-triggered task responding to supported GitHub pull-request activity.
adapters.documented_ceiling: Up to 30 event-triggered executions per hour and 720 per day across event-triggered tasks on eligible plans.
adapters.potential_value: Could turn durable GitHub progress/handoff events into lower-latency wakes without paid API or always-on PC.
proof_required: supported PR event can be generated by RRuleR control flow
triggered Work invocation can reconstruct RRuleR durable state

adapters.potential_value: May reduce dependence on frequent wakes if a worker can continue after the user leaves.
proof_required: scheduled/event-triggered invocation can enter or delegate to compatible background execution
runtime lifetime materially exceeds current invocation span

next_feasibility_experiment: When provisioning capability is available outside this already-running scheduled turn, create a bounded non-recursive GitHub PR event-trigger proof and measure event-to-worker latency before considering adapter promotion.
